content.value: You are designing a data-entry procedure for a new user registration form. The business (10) [CO1] rules state that a password must be at least 8 characters long and contains at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one digit. Create a regular expression that could be used to validate that a password meets these requirements.
